name: matmul
algorithm: One i-k-j product of two n * n f64 matrices with 8-bit inputs from splitmix64 (Fill, untimed, also zeroes c), then the exact sum of c as trunc(total * 2^16) (Run, timed); the algorithm of ../../same/matmul with rounds = 1.
measures: the inner loop's vectorisation under Mk's bounds checks and checked index arithmetic, against C with none (both no FMA)
